about: lib/printer-activity.js: each protocol's state words (sources in the module header) → {link, activity}; `main` is lib/attention.js machineState on main before C2, `legacy` its value once every fix class is on. A class not yet fixed must read `main`. Synthetic entries.

cases.why: manual offline wins over a printing poll
no printer API, never polled: unpaired (legacy idle)
a printer API, never heard from: connecting (legacy unknown)
HTTP 401 kept by the poller: unauthorized (legacy as a failing poll)

entry.error: The printer refused the API key

cases.why: 403 in the error words, no status kept: unauthorized
a 500 kept by the poller, words mention "access code": the status wins, not unauthorized
unknown word "Kneading": the old rule, as main
unknown word "Kneading", progress 10: the old rule, as main
unknown word "SOMETHING_NEW": the old rule, as main
unknown word "SOMETHING_NEW", progress 10: the old rule, as main
unknown word "Printing (custom)": the old rule, as main
unknown word "Printing (custom)", progress 10: the old rule, as main
unknown word "warming up error": the old rule, as main
unknown word "warming up error", progress 10: the old rule, as main
unknown word "": the old rule, as main
unknown word "", progress 10: the old rule, as main
